topic: TTB pm15 nT midnight geomagnetic fluctuation — standard_physics verdict re-review after ISS-3038 station-mislabel patch
change_summary: Single-prediction verification re-review. ISS-3038 (EXP-671) applied a 5-entry patch (detail_reasoning x4, tldr x1) fixing the Tsumeb/TTB station mislabel. Verifying the patch closed the hole cleanly and re-attacking the standard_physics verdict.
our_argument_summary: PRED-072 (our_verdict: standard_physics) argues the dome-predicted pm15 nT H-component fluctuation at local midnight at the station its monitor labels "Tsumeb (TTB)" is the ordinary solar-quiet (Sq) daily variation, understood since Stewart (1882) / Chapman & Bartels (1940), with amplitudes of 10-50 nT at low-to-mid latitude (Yamazaki & Maute 2017). The pm15 nT claim sits inside that band; the dome merely relabels ionospheric dynamo currents as aetheric tidal flow and the midnight minimum as a sub-terrestrial Sump. The prediction restates WIN-042 territory (data/wins.json:042; WIN-042.c4 review; EXP-597 traced the same TSU/TTB conflation in monitor.py). Test window expired 2026-04-11 with no dome result recorded (dome_silent_on_expiry).

dome_code_analysis.calculation_pipeline: Prediction-registry entry, not a WIN with live monitor.py comparison. Verification-class re-review; monitor.py tags not re-derived this run — see WIN-042.c4 / EXP-597 for the station-code source trace.
dome_code_analysis.hardcoded_vs_computed: pm15 nT is stated within the standard Sq band, not derived from dome geometry (disc radius / firmament height). Display-level claim, not a dome-geometric derivation.
dome_code_analysis.escape_clauses: Dome recorded no result; author_status dome_silent_terminal (set 2026-06-09 under the 14d+-silence standardization rule). Silent expiry is the observed pattern for inconclusive/failed dome predictions.
dome_code_analysis.code_discrepancies: None found this run. The IAGA-code correction (TTB=Tatuoca, Brazil; TSU=Tsumeb, Namibia) is now consistent across detail_reasoning and tldr.

code_analysis_tags.monitoring_evidence: Prediction-registry entry that expired with no recorded dome result (window_expired true, dome_silent_on_expiry true, author_status dome_silent_terminal). monitor.py comparison logic for the underlying station was not re-derived this run; the TSU/TTB source trace lives in EXP-597 / WIN-042.c4. Tag reflects the prediction surface, not a re-audit of monitor.py.
code_analysis_tags.relabels_standard_evidence: Diurnal H-component variation at a magnetic observatory is the Sq system, explained by ionospheric dynamo theory since Stewart (1882) / Chapman & Bartels (1940); 10-50 nT amplitude at low-to-mid latitude per Yamazaki & Maute (2017, Space Sci. Rev. 206:299). Dome renames it aetheric tidal flow / sub-terrestrial Sump without a different numerical prediction.
code_analysis_tags.post_hoc_evidence: Entry carries data_predates_registration: true and is_genuinely_prospective: false; notes record INTERMAGNET TTB data publicly available before the claimed 2026-04-04 registration (git commit dated 2026-04-05, 54476366). The pm15 nT figure restates known observatory behavior.
code_analysis_tags.derives_from_dome_evidence: No derivation from dome parameters (disc_radius, firmament_height) to pm15 nT is present; the value is asserted to fall within — and does fall within — the standard Sq band.

holes_found.description:
detail_reasoning contains a literal double-escaped newline sequence (backslash-n backslash-n) at "...inside the well-characterised standard band.\\n\\nThe test window expired April 11...". Everywhere else in the field uses real newline characters (8 real newlines vs this 1 literal pair). The HTML build renders detail_reasoning via

${autolinkUrls(escapeHtml(pred.detail_reasoning))}

(build-scripts/generate-html.js:1085); escapeHtml (line 225) does not touch backslash, so the two-character sequence survives verbatim and readers see a literal backslash-n backslash-n in the published prediction panel. Introduced by the ISS-3038 / EXP-671 patch concatenation where the new equatorial-Tatuoca wrinkle paragraph was joined to the pre-existing test-window paragraph.
holes_found.recommendation: In data/predictions.json PRED-072.detail_reasoning, replace the literal backslash-n backslash-n between "standard band." and "The test window expired" with either a real newline (to match the field convention) or a single space. One-character-class edit; verification: node -e asserting (detail_reasoning.match(/\\n/g)||[]).length === 0.

stronger_arguments.description: The user-visible detail_reasoning leans entirely on the standard-physics relabel and does not surface the prospectivity failure in prose. The registration-date discrepancy (claimed 2026-04-04, git commit 2026-04-05 per 54476366) plus data_predates_registration is arguably a cleaner, harder-to-contest kill than the physics argument, since it does not depend on the reader accepting the Sq-amplitude range. It is currently carried only by structured fields (is_genuinely_prospective:false, data_predates_registration:true) and the notes field, which render separately. Optional: add one sentence to detail_reasoning noting the prediction is non-prospective (data predates registration) so the strongest point is visible in the prose a reader actually expands.

kernel_of_truth.description: The dome correctly identifies a real, repeatable physical signal: low-to-mid-latitude magnetic observatories genuinely do show systematic diurnal H-component fluctuations of order pm10-50 nT around local midnight (data/predictions.json:PRED-072 detail_reasoning; Yamazaki & Maute 2017, Space Sci. Rev. 206:299). Picking pm15 nT is a plausible, falsifiable number that lands inside the observed band rather than an absurd value.
kernel_of_truth.why_it_doesnt_save_claim: Landing inside the standard Sq band is exactly why it is not evidence for the dome: any geophysicist predicts fluctuations of this magnitude from ionospheric dynamo theory without invoking aether (data/predictions.json:PRED-072 detail_reasoning). The dome supplies no dome-geometric derivation of pm15 nT (derives_from_dome:false) and the INTERMAGNET data predates registration (data_predates_registration:true), so a correct-magnitude, non-prospective, standard-mechanism claim confirms known physics, not the ovoid-cavity model.

deeper_analysis: Verification-class re-review triggered by queue_id 599 (decider self-apply after ISS-3038). The ISS-3038/EXP-671 patch cleanly fixed the Tsumeb/TTB station mislabel: TTB is now correctly identified as IAGA code Tatuoca, Brazil, with TSU=Tsumeb, Namibia, and the reasoning is explicitly written to be dispositive under EITHER station identity (mid-latitude Sq for Tsumeb; equatorial F-region tidal dynamics for Tatuoca), which is a robust construction. The two remaining Tsumeb (TTB) strings are correctly attributed to the dome monitor as its mislabel, not asserted by us as fact. Citations spot-checked as real and correctly attributed (IAGA TTB=Tatuoca; TSU=Tsumeb; Sq history Stewart 1882 / Chapman & Bartels 1940; Yamazaki & Maute 2017 10.1007/s11214-016-0282-z; Anderson et al. 2004 10.1029/2004JA010609; Denardini et al. 2016 10.1016/j.asr.2015.09.011). Verdict standard_physics holds. Only defect is the cosmetic literal backslash-n artifact the patch introduced; minor because it does not mislead, but visible to readers so worth a one-character fix. curmudgeon-verify is currently paused, and this target had no prior curmudgeon review, so PROP-038 verify-handoff gate (b) fails and the item correctly stayed in curmudgeon scope.
